inputs.title: Panorama of Spiral Galaxy, M31, with the Wide-field view of the Andromeda Galaxy in its gaps
inputs.credit: Local Group Survey Team and T.A. Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage)/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA; outer disc: ESA/Hubble & Digitized Sky Survey 2, acknowledgment Davide De Martin (ESA/Hubble)
inputs.acquisition: Built offline by packages/bake/authoring/m31/compose-optical.mts from two publisher images: the NOIRLab Large JPEG of the Local Group Survey panorama (source/lggs-panorama.jpg, restored from its origin) and the ESA/Hubble heic1112f crop (source/source.jpg). Both are resampled into one frame along the major axis at 2 arcsec per pixel; the DSS2 view fills the survey mosaic's notches and the outer disc, histogram-matched to the survey over the pixels both cover (source/optical-composite.json). The hash identifies the local composite, not a calibrated scientific array.
inputs.license: CC-BY-4.0 (both images); provider terms: https://noirlab.edu/public/copyright/ and https://esahubble.org/copyright/. Retain the complete recorded credits.

attributions.label: Local Group Survey (KPNO Mayall 4-m, Mosaic)
attributions.reason: The publisher's colour composite of ten Mosaic pointings in U, B, V, I and H-alpha; the retained record does not identify the individual exposures.

attributions.label: Digitized Sky Survey 2
attributions.reason: The published display combines DSS2 red and blue survey plates. The retained record does not identify the individual plate exposures and acquisition instruments; ESA/Hubble is the publisher, not evidence of Hubble telescope acquisition.
